Name: Furniture Shops
Author: nancyxdrewx
Description:
Adds 4 shop catalogues you can buy for Pierre's, Marnie's, Willy's, and Joja Mart. You can place them anywhere and right click them to open the shop menu. Will include any mod added items sold in these shops. Shop catalogues are sold in their respective shops. Catalogue prices are fully adjustable in the config. The default prices for Willy's and Marnie's are 250,000 and Pierre's and Joja's are 500,000 for some semblance of balance (but feel free to change this).

You can change the shop furniture style in the config, either Vending Machine (default) or Table. (thanks so much [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Huskyn1nja/mods?gameId=1303]Huskyn1nja [/url]<3) If you want to use the new sprites after already purchasing one you will need to repurchase or spawn one in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] sorry!

Downloads.Description: Adds shops as furniture. Added Piper compatibility and French translation (thanks to vin163). Added new shop sprites (thanks to Huskyn1nja). To use the new sprites you must spawn in/buy a new catalogue sorry!
